# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

We are committed to a respectful, inclusive, and professional community for all contributors.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and constructive.
- Assume positive intent and collaborate professionally.
- Give and receive feedback with empathy.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, or personal attacks.
- Publishing private or sensitive information.
- Disruptive, abusive, or hostile conduct.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers are responsible for clarifying standards and may remove or reject content that violates this policy.

## Reporting

Report behavior concerns privately to repository maintainers.
